Archetype: Plini X.blurb: Plini's progressive/fusion rig — boutique cleans, British crunch and lush time effects.

Archetype: Gojira X.blurb: Joe Duplantier's Gojira tones — pristine cleans to crushing high gain, plus octave and Whammy-style pitch.

Soldano SLO-100 X.blurb: A dedicated model of the Soldano SLO-100, the amp that originated American high gain.

Fortin Nameless Suite X.blurb: The Fortin Nameless extreme-metal amp with Zuul gate and Grind boost — tight, brutal metal.

Archetype: Cory Wong X.blurb: Cory Wong's funk toolkit — compressed cleans, the DI 'bubble' tone, wah and envelope filter.

Archetype: Nolly X.blurb: Adam 'Nolly' Getgood's modded amp collection and IRs — polished modern-metal production tones.

Parallax X.blurb: Multiband bass distortion for modern metal bass.

Archetype: John Mayer X.blurb: John Mayer's studio rig — three unobtainable clean amps, his pedals and studio effects.

Archetype: Petrucci X.blurb: John Petrucci's prog-metal rig — Mark-flavoured rhythm and lead, piezo amp and rack effects.

Archetype: Misha Mansoor X.blurb: Misha Mansoor's modern-metal toolkit — Horizon Devices pedals, experimental effects and three amps.

Archetype: Rabea X.blurb: Rabea Massaad's versatile rig — Cali cleans to modern high gain, plus the Overlord synth.

Archetype: Tim Henson X.blurb: Tim Henson's Polyphia tones — acoustic amp, Multivoicer harmonies and lush time effects.
